grounding.states: Burlington store hours differ between sources on Mondays
grounding.from: Hours are inconsistent. Apple Maps shows it closed on Monday, October 12, 2026. Waze and Yellow Pages show Monday 9:00 am to 8:30 pm. Yelp shows Monday 10:00 am to 8:30 pm.

value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco there yet. The Oakville store is slated to open in 2027. The open ones I found are in Burlington at 1225 Brant St, and on Laird Rd in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd, which one deals site says also serves Oakville. I couldn't work out which one is closer from what I found. The Burlington store's Monday hours are listed differently across sources.
